recalled_knowledge.item: Lindhard quenching L = k g/(1+kg), eps = 11.5 E Z^-7/3, k = 0.133 Z^2/3 A^-1/2
W = 13.7 eV (NEST v2) and 13.5 eV per quantum
NEST v2 NR mean-yield functional form (N_q = alpha E^beta; Q_y = 1/(sigma (E+eps)^p) with sigmoid turn-ons; L_y = N_q/E - Q_y)
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: NEST v2 source code / Szydagis et al. 2022

recalled_knowledge.item: Lenardo et al. 2015 global fit: Lindhard k ~ 0.139 with W = 13.7 eV
LUX D-D (2016) total-quanta Lindhard fit k ~ 0.17
Aprile 2006 measured L_eff at 10.4-56.5 keV, roughly flat ~0.2
Manzur 2010 (4-66 keV) and Plante 2011 (3-66 keV) L_eff rising ~0.09 to ~0.19
L_eff is an S1-only quantity relative to 122 keV gamma at zero field, not the Lindhard L
n-Xe elastic kinematics E_R,max = 4 m_n M/(m_n+M)^2 E_n

failed_or_abandoned: Quantitative conversion of recalled L_eff values (Aprile 2006, Manzur 2010, Plante 2011) to Lindhard L abandoned: requires zero-field NR photon fraction and 122 keV gamma light yield, recalled only roughly; used qualitatively.
SRIM-like stopping-power calculation of the electronic/nuclear partition not attempted (no offline tables); Lindhard g(eps) used as theory reference.
